description: Installs one extension, documents it and another, and removes a third. Extensions are database-global rather than schema-scoped, so this is the only object kind whose lifecycle happens outside a schema entirely. Every extension left standing carries a comment, because an undocumented one is read back with the description the extension ships and never settles.

sqlserver.because: SQL Server has no extension mechanism, so the scenario's bootstrap state cannot be expressed.

sqlite.because: SQLite has no extension mechanism NSchema can declare, so the scenario's bootstrap state cannot be expressed.
